name: Worldwide stations: broadcasters
source: EiBi shortwave and medium wave schedule, season B26, by Eike Bierwirth, eibispace.de (free for use in third-party software); FCC AM Query, licensed US Class A stations, November 2026. Long wave is in the Worldwide stations list.
note: Broadcasters by home country, with the times they're scheduled in UTC. Schedules change at the end of March and October. Listed isn't heard: reception depends on the hour, the season and where a station aims its signal, and stations change plans at short notice. Local medium wave stations outside the US clear channels aren't listed, unless they also reach abroad.
